spec.definitions: def l1_statement : Prop := ∀ (R B : ℚ), 0 ≤ B → (R ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 ↔ |R| ≤ B)
spec.proof:
by
  intro R B hB
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : |R| ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [sq_abs] using h
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg R) hB).mp h'
  · intro h
    have h' : |R| ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg R) hB).mpr h
    simpa only [sq_abs] using h'
